remarks: Welcome to 22 Leslie Street, Unit #3, a well maintained first-floor apartment located in a quiet neighborhood of Stamford, CT. This 2-bedroom, 1-bath unit features hardwood floors throughout and a recently renovated kitchen equipped with a dishwasher. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry and two dedicated parking spaces. The apartment is pet-friendly, allowing cats and small dogs up to 20 lbs with a one-time, non-refundable pet fee of $250. Ideally located, this unit offers excellent access to Stamford Metro-North Station, public transportation, I-95 and downtown Stamford. You're just minutes from shops, restaurants, and more. Applicants must have good credit and provide proof of income. Available June 1st -Don't miss this opportunity to live in a comfortable, updated home in a prime location!
